body.en:
Question B-002-007-004.

Why the correct answer is right: QSY means change frequency.

Why the distractors are wrong:
- sourceIndex 1: "Use more power": Using more power is the idea of QRO; QSY changes frequency.
- sourceIndex 2: "Send faster": Sending faster is the idea of QRQ; QSY changes frequency.
- sourceIndex 3: "Send more slowly": Sending more slowly is QRS, not QSY.
